rules.title: Broker fee paid only by the party who engaged the broker
rules.requirement: A licensed broker or salesperson may contract with either a prospective tenant or a landlord (or landlord's agent), and any fee may be paid only by the party, lessor or tenant, who originally engaged and contracted with the broker. A tenant who did not engage the broker cannot be charged the broker's fee.
rules.coverage_text: Persons in the business of finding dwelling accommodations for prospective tenants for a fee (licensed brokers and salespersons) and the fees they charge.
rules.citation: General Laws Chapter 112, Section 87DDD 1/2 (as amended by 2025, 9, Sec. 43)
rules.quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
